subject: Enquiry: HACCP food safety training for our kitchen team
text:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We are looking for an in-house HACCP and food handling programme for our central kitchen, around 22 pax. Is this HRD Corp claimable under SBL-Khas? We hope to run it in November.

Thank you.

Lim Mei Ling
Quality Assurance Manager
Greenfield Foods Sdn Bhd
Tel: 03-7960 1234 | Mobile: 016-220 3344
